trust_decision.summary: Whether a presented API token matches a stored credential is decided by comparing the plaintext value directly against the api_tokens.token column (no hash), in the token-lookup queries used by the API firewall authenticator; every writer stores the raw value and the UI reads it back.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'API tokens stored as plaintext'; ApiTokenManager::create is the named token factory that generates and persists the token.

fix_sites.module_kind: security success handler (returns the token in JSON)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/UserBundle/Twig/Components/CreateApiToken.php:56-60 persists a new ApiToken itself with generateToken() and the EntityManager, never calling ApiTokenManager::create (src/ApiBundle/ApiTokenManager.php:46-60); separately, three independent token lookups in two bundles (src/ApiBundle/Security/ApiTokenAuthenticator.php:66, src/UserBundle/Repository/ApiTokenRepository.php:43, src/UserBundle/Repository/ApiTokenHistoryRepository.php:40) must all hash

O3_reason_to_dismiss: CreateApiToken is a UI widget in UserBundle/Twig that already 'uses ApiTokenManager' (it injects it, line 38), so a solver who hashes inside ApiTokenManager::create can believe every writer is covered; the history-repository lookup looks like logging, not authentication.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Authentication must remain an indexed equality lookup (the fix uses deterministic HMAC keyed by kernel.secret); an over-hardened fix with password_hash/bcrypt breaks findOneBy/WHERE token = :token lookups and stops all API auth. POST /api/login and the create UI must still return the plaintext exactly once, and getOrCreate on an existing name can no longer return a usable token (fix returns 409 instead).

O6_input_shapes: token created via POST /api/login with or without token_name (src/ApiBundle/Event/Listener/AuthenticationSuccessHandler.php:36)
token created via profile UI live action (src/UserBundle/Twig/Components/CreateApiToken.php:57)
login for a token name that already exists (fix.diff:190-203)

O7_producer.where: src/UserBundle/Repository/ApiTokenRepository.php:61-85 selects t.token and maps it into the array the UI renders (src/UserBundle/Resources/views/Components/ApiTokens.html.twig:34); the stored value itself is produced by the writers in src/ApiBundle/ApiTokenManager.php:50 and src/UserBundle/Twig/Components/CreateApiToken.php:57

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a token-rotation/regenerate method or console command that sets a new token on an existing ApiToken via setToken() directly
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the entity exposes a public setToken (src/UserBundle/Entity/ApiToken.php:91-96) and the UI writer already bypasses the manager, so a maintainer adding 'regenerate' to the profile page would plausibly copy CreateApiToken's pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second lookup (e.g. findByToken for a webhook or 'revoke by token value' API) querying t.token with the raw value
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: lookups by token value are already duplicated in three places with different styles (QueryBuilder, findOneBy via registry, findOneBy via repository)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: history requestData/serialized entity that carries the presented token value (a serialization boundary the hash check never touches)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: onAuthenticationSuccess already copies the request into history (src/ApiBundle/Security/ApiTokenAuthenticator.php:55-59) right next to where the raw token is in hand

O9_family: CWE-312 cleartext storage of credentials (API bearer tokens stored and displayed unhashed)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Hash in ApiTokenManager::create and in ApiTokenRepository::getUsernameForToken only, leaving the UI writer (CreateApiToken::save), the history-repository and authenticator findOneBy lookups, and the UI read-back unchanged (or use password_hash, which breaks equality lookup).

out_of_scope_notes: API token accepted in the URL query string (?token=) at src/ApiBundle/Security/ApiTokenAuthenticator.php:46,86, so it can land in access/proxy logs; separate CWE-598 concern.

Raw request body of every API call is persisted in ApiTokenHistory.requestData (src/ApiBundle/Security/ApiTokenAuthenticator.php:57, src/UserBundle/Entity/ApiTokenHistory.php:52-53), which may store other secrets.
ApiTokenHistoryRepository::addHistory dereferences a possibly-null token (src/UserBundle/Repository/ApiTokenHistoryRepository.php:42); the fix adds a null guard.
